```suggestion
		You can access a dictionary's value by referencing its corresponding key. In the above example, [code]points_dict["White"][/code] will return [code]50[/code]. You can also write [code]points_dict.White[/code], which is equivalent. However, you'll have to use the bracket syntax if the key you're accessing the dictionary with isn't a fixed string (such as a number or variable). Referencing a dictionary method as a [Callable] requires special handling, since this syntax prioritizes key lookup over built-in methods. For example, [code]some_signal.connect(points_dict.erase)[/code] will lookup the [code]"erase"[/code] key, rather than the [method Dictionary.erase] method.
```

Also, can the special handling be documented in the example? I don't know how you reference the `erase` Callable in this case.
